questions.question:
Which of the following interchanges of signs and numbers would make the given equation correct?

25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : × and +, 30 and 25

Given equation is : 25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 30 - 10 ÷ 5 × 15 + 25 = 55

⇒ 30 - __**10 ÷ 5**__ × 15 + 25 = 55

⇒ 30 - __**2 × 15**__ + 25 = 55

⇒ __**30**__ - 30 __**+ 25**__ = 55

⇒ __**55 - 30**__ = 55

⇒ 25 ≠ 55

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : ÷ and +, 15 and 10

Given equation is : 25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 25 - 15 + 5 ÷ 10 × 30 = 55

⇒ 25 - 15 + __**5 ÷ 10**__ × 30 = 55

⇒ 25 - 15 + __**0.5 × 30**__ = 55

⇒ __**25**__ - 15 __**+ 15**__ = 55

⇒ __**40 - 15**__ = 55

⇒ 25 ≠ 55

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : × and -, 15 and 10

Given equation is : 25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 25 × 15 ÷ 5 + 10 - 30 = 55

⇒ 25 × __**15 ÷ 5**__ + 10 - 30 = 55

⇒ __**25 × 3**__ + 10 - 30 = 55

⇒ __**75 + 10**__ - 30 = 55

⇒ __**85 - 30**__ = 55

⇒ **55 = 55**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : + and -, 5 and 10

Given equation is : 25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 25 + 5 ÷ 10 - 15 × 30 = 55

⇒ 25 + __**5 ÷ 10**__ - 15 × 30 = 55

⇒ 25 + 0.5 - __**15 × 30**__ = 55

⇒ __**25 + 0.5**__ - 450 = 55

⇒ __**25.5 - 450**__ = 55

⇒ -424.5 ≠ 55

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"× and -, 15 and 10".**

questions.question: Why is PC Mahalanobis' name talked about in the context of Five-Year Plans?

options.text: He was the chairman of the Planning Commission.
He established the Institute of Economic Growth.
He conceptualised the framework for the Second Five-Year Plan.
He was the finance minister during the First Five-Year Plan period.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**He conceptualised the framework for the Second Five-Year Plan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis** was an **Indian statistician** who played a significant role in** formulating India's strategy for industrialization in the Second Five-Year Plan (1956–61).**
 
• The Plan, influenced by the Mahalanobis model, stressed the importance of **boosting the public sector's role **in the economy and targeted significant growth in sectors like **steel, electricity, and heavy machinery.**
 
• Although Mahalanobis was not the chairman of the Planning Commission nor the Finance Ministry during this time, his contributions were instrumental for the execution of the economic strategy during the Plan period.
 
• Therefore, his name is often mentioned alongside the development of these five-year plans in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Second Five year plan:**

 
• The Second Five-Year Plan, also known as the **Mahalanobis Plan**, was proposed by Indian statistician Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis in 1955. It was in effect from **1956 to 1961.**
 
• This plan focused on the development of the** public sector** and aimed to create a socialistic pattern of society.
 
• This Plan set the precedence for a predominant role of the state which would determine the **direction of the economy.**

questions.question: Which of the following committees recommended for the inclusion of fundamental duties in the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaran Singh Committee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swaran Singh Committee** was established in **1976** under the leadership of Sardar Swaran Singh, an Indian Politician.
 
• The committee was specifically constituted to study and suggest changes to the Constitution in relation to the concept of** fundamental duties**. It was the Swaran Singh Committee that suggested adding** a new part outlining citizen duties.**
 
• As a result of this committee's recommendations, **the 42nd Amendment to the Constitution in 1976** included the new** Part IVA, **which specified the fundamental duties of Indian citizens. It comprises **Article 51A from (a) to (k).**
 
• The fundamental duties include tenets like respect for the **national flag, the constitution, and institutions, promoting brotherhood, protecting the environment, and upholding scientific temper among others.**
 
• The primary aim behind the inclusion of the Fundamental Duties by this committee was to create a** balance of rights and duties** in the constitution, obliging citizens to act responsibly and assist in maintaining the spirit of democracy in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarkaria Commission:**

 
 
• The Sarkaria Commission was established in 1983 by the central government of India.
 
• The Commission was set up to examine the relationship and balance of power between state and central governments in the country and suggest changes within the framework of the Constitution.
 
• It made 247 recommendations to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and balance between the various levels of government in India.
 
• The report of the Sarkaria Commission is the first and the most comprehensive attempt to review Centre-State relationship.
 
 
 
• **Rajamannar Committee:**
 
 
• The Rajamannar Committee was constituted by the government of Tamil Nadu in 1969.
 
• Its task was to examine the entire question concerning state autonomy and the Centre-State relations.
 
• The committee recommended a drastic overhaul of India’s federal system, with suggestions for the constitution to emerge as a truly federal one rather than quasi-federal.
 
• The need for such changes arose because of the contention that centralization of power diminishes the effectiveness of regional governments.
 
 
 
• **Balwant Rai Mehta Committee:**
 
 
• The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee was a committee appointed by the Government of India in 1957.
 
• The aim of this Committee was to examine the working of the Community Development Programme (1952) and the National Extension Service (1953) and to suggest measures for their better working.
 
• Significantly, their recommendations led to the birth of Panchayati Raj Institutions in India, outlining a three-tier system, including village, block, and district levels.
 
• The report of the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee is considered a landmark in the evolution of local self-government (Panchayati Raj) institutions in India.

questions.question: If (a + b + c) = 20, and a² + b² + c² = 152, find the value of a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc.

Direct formula: a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 1/2 × (a + b + c) × [3(a² + b² + c²) − (a + b + c)²]

⇒ 10 × [456 − 400]

⇒ 10 × 56 = 560

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 20 × 28

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 560
